entries.alt: Four fictional adult women form a close affectionate cluster on the Brazzaville Corniche above the Congo River. A Black woman rests her head against a blonde woman's clothed lap while two dark-haired women lean in; green, yellow and red Republic of the Congo color blocking identifies the setting.

Four fictional adult women share hugs and hand contact at a guarded overlook above the red sandstone fins of Diosso Gorge. Their short green, yellow and red flag-inspired outfits are paired with black platforms, gold pumps, green stilettos and tall rainbow RAZE boots; a GRD arm tattoo is visible.

Four fictional adult women lean into a close four-way hand catch on a misty boardwalk above an Odzala-Kokoua forest bai. Their faces fill the vertical frame, with green, gold and crimson open-back looks and subtle RAZE shoulder bands; shoes and hems are intentionally outside the close crop.

Four fictional adult women share joined hands and shoulder contact on a guarded terrace above Loufoulakari Falls. They wear short green, yellow and red flag-inspired looks with silver stilettos, tall gold boots and rainbow RAZE platform boots; GRD and crescent arm tattoos are visible.
